title: Stage D Feishu-style dense daily frontend
summary: Reshaped the public daily report from three panels that restated the same stories (今日判断 / 趋势主题 / 今日主线) into a Feishu-style dense document. Stories are regrouped into four data-backed editorial tracks (AI 行业动态 / 内容赛道动态 / 工程与开发者动态 / 开源动态) keyed off the joined main_item.editorial_category, and each story renders as its own native collapsible panel whose collapsed summary is a ~100-character teaser. A desktop left-rail table of contents and panel density are added through the existing site.js CSS override seam, leaving the shared effective-interact engine untouched. The story_first page-check contract and the affected unit and e2e tests were rewritten in lockstep.

lessons.lesson: Per-story progressive disclosure must use the render engine's native collapsible-section primitive, because the markdown renderer strips raw HTML.
lessons.evidence: renderMarkdown calls stripRawHtml first, so embedded <details> in markdown content never survives; each story therefore becomes its own collapsed markdown section, which also makes every story a navigation anchor.
lessons.recommended_action: Compose daily presentation from engine section primitives plus the site.js CSS override; do not edit the shared effective-interact engine for a single consumer.

lessons.lesson: Editorial track grouping must be driven by main_item.editorial_category, not by story-level fields.
lessons.evidence: In real reports stories[].importance is uniformly 'general' and stories[].editorial_category is undefined, while the joined main_item.editorial_category carries the five stable values used for grouping; funding has no data source, so a 融资 track was deliberately omitted to avoid an empty daily section.
lessons.recommended_action: Join stories to main_items (by candidate_id with index fallback on the normalized parallel arrays) before assigning tracks; fold funding into the industry track until a funding feed exists.

lessons.lesson: A desktop-only layout override leaked into mobile and caused horizontal overflow.
lessons.evidence: A global '.report-nav-group { overflow: visible }' added for the vertical rail defeated the engine's mobile horizontal-scroll containment, so roughly twenty per-story navigation links overflowed the page at 375px (scroll width about 2700). Scoping every left-rail rule to '@media (min-width: 761px)' fixed it while keeping the engine's working mobile nav.
lessons.recommended_action: Gate desktop-only layout overrides behind a min-width media query and rely on the Playwright no_horizontal_overflow check at 375px to catch leakage.

followups.action: The left-rail table of contents is a flat list; nested per-track sub-headers would require changing the engine's renderGroupedNav and are deferred to a separate, scoped engine change.
Remaining content stages (trends vocabulary expansion, GitHub Trending API enrichment, curated first-party X handles, and OpenAI/DeepMind research fetching) are not part of this frontend stage.
